resources.string: Default rules are bundled from Loyalsoldier/v2ray-rules-dat. Edit a file’s HTTPS download URL, choose a repository preset, or import a local .dat file. Use Download to apply URL changes; failed updates keep the current file.

Keep the filenames geosite.dat and geoip.dat: routing rules refer to these names. Use HTTPS URLs for Xray-compatible protobuf .dat files (not text rules). geosite.dat must include cn and geolocation-!cn; GeoIP files must include cn and private. Saving changes only the source URL; Download validates and replaces the file. For a local file, enter an HTTPS URL to enable future downloads.
Use a plain filename, without folders, path separators, or traversal characters.
Enter a valid HTTPS URL without credentials or a fragment.
Source saved. Current files are unchanged. Use Download to apply the new source.
No remote files to download. Local imports were left unchanged.
Use %1$s for the default rule files? This resets their custom URLs and local-only settings. Current files remain until a successful download.
Replace %1$s with this local file? It will be validated before replacing the current file. Automatic downloads for this file will be disabled until you edit its URL or choose a repository preset.
Rules changed. Return to the main screen to apply them; an active connection will restart.
